name: DiffuSpace Clover-35B-A3B-Preview model card
notes: Fetched 2026-10-29 (README.md). Repo created 2026-10-24, licence apache-2.0, base_model Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Safetensors total 34,661,350,848, dtype bfloat16, ~69 GB at BF16 per the card. The card STATES NO BENCHMARK NUMBERS: its Performance section is a single linked JPEG (https://diffuspace.ai/assets/blog/clover/agentic-benchmarks.jpg) pointing at the launch blog. Everything architectural is on the card and machine-readable: config.json model_type clover_moe, architectures [CloverMoeModelLM], 40 layers with full_attention_interval 4 and explicit layer_types (30 linear_attention, 10 full_attention), 256 routed experts, num_experts_per_tok 8, num_shared_experts 1, moe_intermediate_size 512, hidden 2048, head_dim 256, num_key_value_heads 2, max_position_embeddings 131072, vocab 248320, block_size 32, denoising_config {algorithm: low_confidence, threshold: 0.95}, moe_block_coreset_enabled true, moe_block_coreset_top_p 0.9, attn_output_gate true, rope partial_rotary_factor 0.25 at theta 1e7. Generation controls the card documents as defaults: presence_penalty 0.9, repetition_penalty 1.05, dllm_length_penalty 10.0, dllm_think_end_bias 10.0. Requires trust_remote_code and transformers 5.19.0. The card explicitly warns that the HF PyTorch path and the SGLang kernels disagree on generated text and recommends SGLang for evaluation.
